leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a generic Pick type using keyof and mapped types
Apply the Pick generic to extract specific properties from existing interfaces
Construct type-safe functions that accept only selected object properties
Configure generic constraints to ensure keys exist on the source type
Manipulate object types by selecting subsets of their properties
Initialize variables with types derived from Pick generic usage
Integrate the Pick generic into existing type definitions and function signatures
